title: Cost-Per-Verified-Success KPI (M1-M3)
scope_note: M1-M3 only. M4 (measured baseline) is Mark-gated and OUT OF SCOPE.

milestones.name: Capture and Compute
milestones.description: Propagate 5 verify_* fields into both EvalAssessment constructors; add cohort/baseline filter to EvalQueryOptions; add strict observatory rollup computing the KPI from banked eval_assessment JSON via QueryEvalResults + ClassifyStageCost + CostRollup.TotalKnownCost().
acceptance_criteria: Fixtures distinguish pass-only, verified success, verifier failure, skipped proof, quota, estimated cost, unknown cost
Numerator = reported+estimated exactly, includes failed-run cost
VERIFIED-success predicate defined exactly once in the rollup
Both eval paths bank all 5 verify fields; no DB migration
milestones.notes: Propagated 5 verify_* fields into both EvalAssessment constructors (agent + standard). Added SourceRefPrefix/CreatedAfter/CreatedBefore cohort filter to EvalQueryOptions with a conditional JOIN to execution_chains in QueryEvalResults. Added cost_per_verified_success.go with the single isVerifiedSuccess predicate + computeCostPerVerifiedSuccess rollup reusing ClassifyStageCost/CostRollup.TotalKnownCost(). 11 new tests (incl 7-case table) all PASS; make check-boundaries OK; lint 0 issues.

milestones.name: Expose and Publish
milestones.description: Extend chains stats CLI + GET /api/chains/stats via the same rollup; add additive latest.json headlineKpis.costPerVerifiedSuccess. Field-for-field identical across CLI/HTTP/exporter. Strict mode fails loudly.
acceptance_criteria: CLI JSON, HTTP JSON, published snapshot have identical numerator/denominator/quotient/completeness
Strict mode exits non-zero on unknown cost, missing verification, zero denominator, cohort mismatch
latest.json headline object is additive; existing fields stable
milestones.notes: CLI: added --cost-per-verified-success + --baseline to chains stats (chains_stats_cvs.go), reuses Store.CostPerVerifiedSuccess, --strict exits 2 when unavailable (verified end-to-end against real DB: empty cohort => available:false reason:empty_cohort, exit 2). HTTP: handleChainsStats routes cost_per_verified_success=true to handleCostPerVerifiedSuccess, additive, same rollup, baseline required (400 without). Publisher: added additive DashboardJSON.HeadlineKpis + AttachHeadlineKpi (eval_analysis/headline_kpi.go) that round-trips the SAME struct so CLI==HTTP==snapshot field-for-field. Tests: field-for-field identity, additive-stability, unknown-cost/zero-denominator/missing-baseline strict failures, default-stats-unregressed. All PASS; check-boundaries OK; lint 0 issues.

milestones.name: Headline Dashboard
milestones.description: KPI card atop ValueDashboard before Value Score / QualityScatter; benchmarkFetch source signal + visible Fallback/stale badge; available / zero-denominator / incomplete / absent states.
acceptance_criteria: Card appears before Value Score / QualityScatter, handles available/zero-denom/incomplete states
Fallback badge verified by component/data-logic fixture
Existing per-model $/success, ELO, Pareto, speed, mode toggle, GCS fetch + fallback unchanged
milestones.notes: Added benchmarkFetchWithSource (additive; benchmarkFetch unchanged so existing callers unbroken) returning {response, source: gcs|fallback}. Added pure headlineKpiState.js (deriveHeadlineKpiState -> available/incomplete/zero_denominator/absent + isFallback) and HeadlineKpiCard.jsx rendering all 4 states + visible Fallback/stale badge. Wired card ATOP ValueDashboard before Quality-vs-Cost/Value Score; ValueScoreTable per-model $/success untouched. Verification (browserless per repo convention): headlineKpiState.fixture.mjs 7/7 data-logic checks PASS under plain node; both JSX files Babel-compile clean (@babel/preset-react); benchmarkFetch + new exports intact. No headless browser used.
